bagPolicy.summary: DAR’s venue FAQ and visitor-services guide do not publish a general bag dimension or clear-bag rule; any show-specific restrictions come from its presenter.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Hall has no guest parking on DAR grounds. Metered streets and a nearby Colonial Parking garage serve event guests.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
